The Master Mind Scholarship is KU Leuven's flagship award for outstanding international master's students, cutting tuition to the EU/EEA rate and adding an allowance of EUR 10,000 per year. The 2027-2028 round opens late in 2026 with a deadline around February — the scholarship page carries the confirmed dates each season.

Programme Highlights

  • Tuition at the EU/EEA level plus EUR 10,000 annual allowance
  • Requires a prior degree from a university outside Belgium with strong grades
  • Annual round tied to the master's admission application
  • Available across most KU Leuven international master's programmes

Who Should Apply

International students with excellent academic records applying to KU Leuven or UHasselt master's programmes; a high GPA from the prior degree is essential.

Funding and Costs

Tuition fee reduced to the EU/EEA level plus a EUR 10,000 allowance for international scholarship holders.

Deadline and How to Apply

Apply for the master's programme first, then follow the Master Mind scholarship instructions on the KU Leuven scholarships page by the announced deadline. Key deadline information: Annual round for 2027-2028: applications open late 2026 with a deadline around February — confirm on the scholarship page.

Official Link

  • Official application page (verified link)

About KU Leuven

KU Leuven is a research university in Belgium with origins dating to 1425. It offers undergraduate, master's and doctoral programmes across science, engineering, medicine, humanities and social sciences. Its academic community connects teaching with research and international collaboration, supporting students and researchers pursuing questions across a broad range of disciplines.

Official website: https://www.kuleuven.be

Contact

Questions about this position, eligibility or the application process should be raised through the contact channel given on the official announcement page (see the Official Link section above). Always quote the position reference in your message so the admissions or HR team can route your enquiry quickly.

Important Notes

  • Application deadline: Annual round - see official page - late or incomplete applications are normally not considered.
  • Listing details were recorded from the official source at the time of publication; always confirm the latest requirements on the official page before applying.
  • Prepare the documents listed in the eligibility and application sections before starting the online form - transcripts, CV and references take the longest to collect.
